scientific_question: Under one fixed even-frame keyframe budget, can bounded zero-fill per-view shift-scale transport preserve the frozen v16 field/gradient/observation compatibility envelope on every fit trajectory, and does a nondeployable proposal-visible diagnostic show that this exact transport family has enough headroom to justify a later causal native-skip implementation?

fixed_schedule.resource_interpretation: counterfactual mechanism ceiling only; all 101 parent proposals are generated before scoring

must_bind: runner, validator, mechanism, and test SHA-256
geometry, checkpoint, parameter, and native library SHA-256
READY, checksums, manifest, observations, and gauge truth SHA-256 for all five trajectories

motion_contract.estimator: independent exhaustive integer translation per native detector view
motion_contract.warp_boundary: zero fill; cyclic wrap is forbidden
motion_contract.tie_break: minimum residual, then minimum L1 shift, then minimum absolute dy, then minimum absolute dx, then encoded signed shift
motion_contract.oracle_motion_source: current and latest-keyframe full CNN proposals; diagnostic only
motion_contract.residual_correction: six frozen native detector-channel scalar gains
motion_contract.residual_correction_fit: other four trajectories only in each outer fold

arms.proposal: full parent proposal on every frame
causal linear extrapolation from the latest two exact keyframes
warp latest exact keyframe proposal using observation-visible motion
observation-visible motion warp plus fit-only six-channel aligned residual correction
warp latest exact keyframe proposal using motion estimated from the unavailable current full proposal
arms.role: nondeployable bounded per-view proposal-L2 shift-scale diagnostic; not a mathematical upper bound on final reconstruction

solver.learned_and_temporal_arms: proposal -> exact A^T -> observable alpha clipped to [0,2] -> unchanged strict CGLS K1
solver.reference: zero initialization -> unchanged strict CGLS K4

accuracy_gates.aggregation: every trajectory must pass independently; pooled-frame rescue is forbidden
accuracy_gates.skipped_only_thresholds: the same joint matched, joint harm, per-metric harm, and severe-harm limits are applied again to the 50 non-keyframes
accuracy_gates.proposal_tail_for_method_comparison: p90 over the 50 skipped frames only

motion_added_value_gate.proposal_requirement: trajectory-equal median of skipped-only per-trajectory proposal p90 must be at least 5% lower than the best control median
motion_added_value_gate.best_control_selection: choose one control arm with the lowest trajectory-equal median skipped-only proposal p90; use that same arm for every final compatibility comparison
motion_added_value_gate.final_no_harm_requirement: on every trajectory, skipped-only joint matched fraction may be at most 0.01 below the selected best control and skipped-only joint harm fraction may be at most 0.01 above that same control; severe harm remains zero
motion_added_value_gate.channel_delta_role: reported diagnostic only; it cannot rescue a failed primary arm

predeclared_decision_order: If the oracle proposal-motion hold arm fails all-frame or skipped-only compatibility on any trajectory, return FAIL_BOUNDED_PER_VIEW_PROPOSAL_L2_WARP_DIAGNOSTIC_V19 and reject only this exact per-view integer shift plus scalar family under the frozen proposal-L2 selector.
If the oracle passes every trajectory but observation-motion hold fails any trajectory, return FAIL_OBSERVATION_MOTION_IDENTIFIABILITY_V19.

If observation-motion hold passes every trajectory but is not better than fixed hold, diagonal delta, or linear extrapolation in proposal p90 and final compatibility tails, return PASS_SIMPLE_TEMPORAL_HEADROOM_NO_MOTION_VALUE_V19.
Only if observation-motion hold passes every trajectory and adds value over all deployable controls may a separate nested event gate and native causal worker be authorized.

failure_actions.oracle_diagnostic_failure: stop this exact bounded per-view integer shift plus scalar family; do not claim mathematical impossibility of other transport models and do not open p33, fresh, validation, or test data
failure_actions.observation_identifiability_failure: record that the shell exists but deployment-visible observations do not identify it under this contract
failure_actions.control_dominance: retain only the winning simple temporal control and do not claim motion-model value
failure_actions.motion_headroom_pass: freeze a separate nested causal gate and true native-skip runtime protocol before any resource claim
